texts.pulse: PULSE ENERGY GRID CISO · 2024-05-27 · PEAK 26,793 MW The invisible machine that powers everything. Animated introduction: one day of California's grid drawn as 24 petals, one per hour, noon at the top. Each petal's area is the electricity used in that hour. It fills from the centre with solar, wind, nuclear, hydro, imports and other sources, and gas burns at the rim. A grid keeps no stock. Every hour, supply has to meet demand exactly. FROM: EIA-930 / CISO 2022-09-06 18:00 PEAK DEMAND 51,104 MW. EVERY MEGAWATT HAD TO BE MADE OR IMPORTED IN THAT SAME HOUR. OBSERVED · EIA-930 FROM: EIA-930 / ERCO 2024-08-20 18:00 ERCOT PEAKED AT 85,544 MW, WITH NET INTERCHANGE AVERAGING 0.46% OF DEMAND. OBSERVED · EIA-930 OBSERVED · EIA-930 · 1 PETAL = 1 HOUR AREA = MW · NOON AT TOP · CLEANEST AT THE CENTRE
